summary: Dependency resolved from an off-registry HTTPS URL, executing unpinned remote code at install time
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's sole dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a bare HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever tarball that host returns and installs it, running any lifecycle scripts it contains, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no registry provenance. Whoever controls artifacts.koliroute.com can therefore change the delivered bytes at any time and execute arbitrary code on the installing machine. The shipped code is a 55-byte index.js that only re-exports that dependency (module.exports = require('linker-client-string-async')), and the manifest carries placeholder metadata (author "Package Registry", description "Generated package", repository pointing at github.com/example/), so the off-registry dependency line is effectively the package's entire payload. The absence of lifecycle scripts in this package and the inert stub do not prevent the fetch and installation of the remote source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
